tasks.original_prompt:
Anemia follow-up: from the first low hemoglobin in the current run, was a repeat drawn, what did it show, and is the most recent value still low?
Context: patient MRN SYN-0fc3d14af4 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2022-09-29, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"low": ..., "rechecked": ..., "recheck": ..., "recheck_ordered": ..., "latest": ..., "still_low": ...}. low is the first result of the most recent run of consecutive low results, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). rechecked (boolean) is whether any result is dated after low. recheck is the first result after low (same keys), and recheck_ordered (YYYY-MM-DD) the authoredOn date of the ServiceRequest its basedOn references; both null when not rechecked. latest is the most recent result (same keys) and still_low (boolean) whether it is low. Every field is null when no result is low. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (low, the recheck and its ServiceRequest, and latest; when no result is low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

Context: patient MRN SYN-0fc3d14af4 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2022-10-08, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. The last follow-up visit is the most recent Encounter with status finished, a type coding with code followup-coordination and a period start on or before the as-of date; its clinician is the one Practitioner among its participants, and the clinic is the organization of the PractitionerRole whose practitioner is that clinician. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ...}: latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low. Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinic with that Organization and $result with the latest result: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinic"}], "about": [{"reference": "$result"}]}. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, the Encounter, the PractitionerRole and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
